scientific_integrity: The determinant and Smith form are derived from exact integral operations and replayable source; no independent proof audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact graph-theoretic Smith form on the canonical 26-vertex complex surface incidence graph; not a surface Picard discriminant and not a Frobenius result. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Integral critical group of the exceptional-curve–conic-pencil incidence graph on a quartic del Pezzo surface
